name: hookswap-locker-indexer
description: HookSwap Locker data service — enumerates all token/LP locks across the 7 HookSwap chains via RPC (tokenLockerCount + getTokenLockData), aggregates per-token/per-pool + global TVL, records daily TVL snapshots, and serves a read API for the locker analytics UI (explore table, stats, TVL history, shareable lock/pool pages). No mock data: unpriced tokens report native-only, honest nulls otherwise.
